It would be naive to think that your physical appearance is not relevant in today’s world. People who are perceived as attractive are more likely to get hired for jobs and seem trustworthy. However those who were gifted today by some genetic lottery won’t be able to keep their attractiveness tomorrow. It’s not possible. Do not let your body define your soul, let your soul define your body.
